name: design
description: Phase 2 (Design) worker — IN PROGRESS at v0.2.0: `help` and `init` work; the other thirteen commands in the design specification are declared-not-built and labelled as such in commands/help.md, so invoking one produces nothing rather than a guess. Turns the requirement spine produced by `req` into two renderings of one truth: a Thai narrative document a client can sign, and structured JSON downstream plugin agents act on without asking a clarifying question. Reads req through scripts/req-contract.mjs, the single place that knows the shape of req output, and HALTS with exit 2 naming the path it looked for when a mandatory input is absent or malformed rather than inferring it. Ownership is per file, never per folder: no JSON file is written by two plugins even for disjoint fields, because regeneration rewrites the whole file and the other party data disappears silently — so the trace graph is split by author and joined at read time by ID. Every command is idempotent, reads design.state.json before acting, updates it on completion, and writes nothing without --write.
